title: One operator, one index
description: The reference node as deployed today: one administration, one database, discovery and peer synchronisation off, every native rule enforced. A basic deployment that says exactly what it is.

admission.nativeRules: tm_dpp admits a state on the record model's rules, the configured publisher key and the selected custody policy; tm_attestation admits an anchor on its exact script, framed signature and derived key, optionally restricted to named anchoring services; tm_uora_dpp serves the historical format only.

publisherPolicy.keySet: Publisher identity keys are configured explicitly (SERVICE_IDENTITY_KEY, ANCHOR_SERVICE_KEYS), never derived from the operator's own key, and named in the capability document.
publisherPolicy.historicalAuthorisation: A state's publisher signature is verified against a key that was authorised at the state's time; the current allowlist alone is not authority for a historical state.
publisherPolicy.handover: A publisher handover is a signed authorisation record under the selected governance policy with the old key's evidence preserved; it never moves a token spending key, which only the custody mechanism can move.

discovery.notes: No SHIP or SLAP advertisement; clients pin the host.

synchronisation.deduplication: Admission of a held outpoint is a no-op; an anchor is deduplicated by outpoint and digest.
synchronisation.proofUpdates: Proofs arrive through POST /arc-ingest, are validated against the header source before storage and never replay held outputs.
synchronisation.bounds: Request body 8 MiB, lookup 500 outputs, anchor page 100 default and 500 maximum.
synchronisation.reorganisation: A proof the header source refutes returns the state to pending until repaired.

retention.spentStates: Spent passport states are retained as history through coinsToRetain.
retention.anchorLeaves: Anchor outputs are retained and indexed; eviction follows the engine's rules.
retention.bytes: Every admitted transaction's BEEF is stored once per transaction.

acceptance.exercise: Admit the pinned chain and anchor fixtures over HTTP and serve them back byte-identical.
Re-announce every admitted output and observe no duplicate index entry.
Serve a capability document that validates against the schema and says discovery and synchronisation are off.
acceptance.evidence: proposed: GET /capabilities on the reference node

unsupported.reason: One administration cannot claim independently replicated evidence.
Advertising needs a funded wallet the reference node does not hold.
